subject: general
question: Who has won the Best Actor and Best Director awards at the 2025 Critics Choice Awards?

options.text: Adrien Brody (Best Actor), Jon M. Chu (Best Director)
Brad Pitt (Best Actor), Christopher Nolan (Best Director)
Tom Hanks (Best Actor), Steven Spielberg (Best Director)
Kieran Culkin (Best Actor), James Cameron (Best Director)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Adrien Brody (Best Actor), Jon M. Chu (Best Director).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Adrien Brody won Best Actor for his performance in The Brutalist, while Jon M. Chu won Best Director for Wicked at the 2025 Critics Choice Awards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adrien Brody w**as recognized for his performance in **The Brutalist, securing the Best Actor award.**
 
• **Jon M. Chu’s surprise win for Best Director (Wicked) **was met with loud applause, as he was not nominated for an Oscar.
 
• Other notable winners include **Demi Moore (The Substance, Best Actress)** and** Zoe Saldaña (Emilia Pérez, Best Supporting Actress).**
 
• The Critics Choice Awards also honored television, with **Shogun winning Best Drama Series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other Major Film Awards:__

 __
 
• Best Picture:__ Anora
 
• __Best Actress:__ Demi Moore (The Substance)
 
• __Best Supporting Actor:__ Kieran Culkin (A Real Pain)
 
• __Best Supporting Actress:__ Zoe Saldaña (Emilia Pérez)
 
• __Best Comedy:__ A Real Pain & Deadpool & Wolverine (tie)
 
• __Best Adapted Screenplay:__ Conclave
 
• __Best Original Screenplay:__ The Substance
